title: Monster
description: A monster template (03-GAME-DESIGN §11.2–§11.3, §4.5, §6.5; the entries of 06-MONSTERS.md §3). Everything about a monster derives from its level and this template: the multipliers scale the band's baseline, the attacks are its moves, parts are what it drops. One file per monster under content/monsters/<id>.json; bosses and hunters are monsters with the boss or hunter block filled.

familyId.description: The monster family (one per zone; every family has all five roles). Families map to a material family and a floor band (06 §1).

rows.description: Rows this monster may be placed in (§3.3).

levelBand.description: Monster levels this template appears at.

multipliers.description: Scale the level's baseline stats (1.0 = the band's ordinary monster).

speed.description: Timeline Speed (§3.1), 100 = a hero at all 10s.

xpClass.description: XP weight before the difficulty curve (§5.1): 1 fodder, 2 special, 3 elite, 6 hunter/monster, 25 boss.

ambushModifier.description: This monster's individual surprise modifier in percentage points (06 §8.3: rats +15, bats +10, constructs −15); an encounter uses the highest in it, not the sum.

statusImmune.description: Statuses that never apply (06 §7: Undead shrug off Poison and Fear, bone also Bleed).

behavior.description: The monster's gambit: ordered if/then lines in the same language as hero AI rules (§3.6), first match wins; the last line is the default.

if.description: A condition, e.g. 'self HP < 25%' or 'ally count < 2'; 'always' for the default.

then.description: An action: an attack id, 'flee', 'guard' or 'swap row'.

fleesAtPercent.description: HP% at which it tries to leave the fight; 0 never flees.

parts.description: What a kill rolls (§6.5): a common part at 35%, a rare part at 4%; a part break doubles the rare roll.

breakLimb.description: A marked limb; hitting it in combat applies the effect and doubles the rare roll. null when the monster has none.

monsterTechniqueSkillIds.description: Skill ids heroes can Insight while this monster uses the move (§7.5; 06 §3 'Technique:' lines). One monster may teach several classes (the Bone Knight teaches the Warden's Bone Knight's Stand and the Blade's Ghoul's Grasp); empty when it teaches nothing. The linter checks each is a Tier III–IV class skill whose monsterTechniqueOf is this monster.

elitePool.description: Elite affix ids this monster may spawn with when it fills an Elite room as the champion (06 §2). Empty for Monsters, bosses and hunters, which are never promoted.

boss.description: Boss rules; null for everything that is not a boss.

hunter.description: Floor-hunter rules (§4.5, 06 §3 'Stalking:' lines); null for everything that is not a hunter.

variantOf.description: The monster whose mesh this re-tints or re-scales; null for a base mesh.

reads200px.description: Passed the phone readability check: the silhouette reads at 200px.

id.description: Unique within the monster; behavior lines and boss phases refer to it.

multiplier.description: Scale of the monster's Attack (1.0 = a basic hit); 0 for a move that does not hit.

target.description: Who it hits; the monster's enemies are the heroes.

effects.description: Lines beyond the hit itself (statuses, timeline pushes, summons).

aiWeight.description: Relative pick weight among the attacks available (the phase's list for a boss) when no behavior rule chooses; 06's lines sum to 100 per phase, but the sim normalises.

tell.description: The one-line warning shown the turn before a telegraphed move (06 §8.10); null for an untelegraphed one. A telegraphed attack is wound up on the monster's turn and lands on its next (sim/src/arena.ts).

hint.description: The tell's two-word hint the HUD shows the first time it fires ('Netter reloading'; 06 §8.10, D-099). Optional; the attack's name stands in.

aim.description: Whom a single-target attack picks among the heroes it can reach (06's 'on the hero with the lowest HP %', 'the most Momentum', 'the lowest Strength'). Optional; absent: the monster's behaviour and hooks choose.

materialId.description: Item id of the material unit.

itemId.description: Item id of a rare part (an affix stone, a pet egg or a special).

quantity.description: Units per drop; bosses drop a guaranteed stack of 5–10.

boss.description: Zone bosses have 2 phases, final bosses 3 and an arena rule (§11.3). The room, the arena rule's wording and add timing are 07-DUNGEONS.md §2.8's; the phases, attacks and drops are 06-MONSTERS.md's.

atHpPercent.description: The phase begins when HP falls to this percent; the first phase is 100.

attacks.description: Attack ids available in this phase.

adds.description: Monsters summoned when the phase begins.

arenaRule.description: 07 §2.8's arena rule for the phase in words (the HUD's line); the sim runs the arena from boss.arena.rules and the phase fields below. Null when none.

name.description: 06's name for the phase ('the Captain's Table').

light.description: The arena light when the phase begins (07 §2.8): set to a value (Vexa's phase 2: 40) or stepped by an amount (the Warden's lantern −20, the King's snuff −25).

speed.description: The boss's Speed from this phase on (06 §3.4: the King's phase 3, 120).

row.description: The row the boss moves to when the phase begins (Vexa steps down, Naesa walks into the water, the King descends).

size.description: The boss's size from this phase on (Naesa Medium → Large, the King Large → Huge).

opener.description: An attack id: the boss's first move of the phase (Vexa kicks the barricade over); its tell, if any, still shows first.

tide.description: The arena's water jumps to at least this step when the phase begins (Naesa's phase 2: 3; the throne's phase 3: 4).

statusImmune.description: Statuses the boss shrugs off from this phase on (06 §3.4's phase 3: Petrify, Grab, Fear).

hooks.description: Custom lines installed on the boss when the phase begins (Naesa's Silence aura).

everyKill.description: Lines every kill gives (08 §11 'Every kill'; 06: 'later kills'): the material stack, the grade-rolled item, stones, and chance lines such as the God item at 1% (a separate line per difficultyMin) or the Divine Shard at 10%.

firstKill.description: Lines the first kill adds on top of everyKill (06 §3 'First-kill drops', 08 §11 'First kill adds'): the zone Relic, the Tier III+ Tome, chest keys, a title, the zone's Waystone, +1 Luck on a final boss. Hard/Dread extras carry difficultyMin.

immunities.description: Statuses a boss shrugs off (06 §7: Petrify, Grab, Web, Root, Fear; Stun becomes Daze).

cannotFlee.description: Always true for bosses (§12.1); kept explicit so the sim reads one field.

parts.description: The boss's breakable parts (06 §3 'Part-breaks'): each breaks once, on one blow of at least hpPercent of the boss's max HP of one of its damage types (any when empty), a critical hit when crit. The monster's parts.breakLimb stays the single-limb rule of everything else.

arena.description: A boss's arena (07 §2.8 owns the room, the arena rule, add timing, the tells and the light): the room template, 07's tells table rows with their two-word hints (D-099), and the rules the sim runs (sim/src/arena.ts; content/README.md 'Boss arenas').

room.description: The room template id (cel-t-tap-room, cry-t-wardens-vigil, vlt-t-drowned-chapel, vlt-t-throne).

cue.description: 07 §2.8's cue, one turn before what it warns of.

arenaRule.description: One arena rule from the closed vocabulary sim/src/arena.ts implements (content/README.md 'Boss arenas' lists each kind's fields); every number is the arena's own.

phases.description: The phases it runs in; absent: every phase.

tell.description: An id of arena.tells shown the round before the rule fires.

every.description: A clock: fires every N rounds of its phase.

params.description: A rule's named knobs (hpPercent, accuracy, critBonus, chainPercent, grab …; content/README.md).

hpPercent.description: One blow of at least this % of the boss's max HP (06: 'Blunt, 6 % HP').

damageTypes.description: The blow's damage types; empty: any hit on the prop.

crit.description: Only a critical hit breaks it (06: the coin, 'a Pierce crit').

fromPhase.description: It exists from this phase on (Naesa's arms, phase 2).

effect.description: What breaking it costs the boss (sim/src/arena.ts).

levelOffset.description: Levels above the floor's band the hunter spawns at (06 §3: level = floor + 3). The default is 3; the linter warns when it differs from the dungeon's other hunters.

entersAtTick.description: Floor-clock tick at which it enters (§4.5: 40).

roomsPerTick.description: Rooms moved toward the party per tick (§4.5: one room every 2 ticks = 0.5).

cannotFlee.description: Whether the party may flee the hunter's fight.

guaranteedRarePart.description: Drops the rare part on every kill (§4.5).

movesDuringRest.description: Keeps moving while the party rests (07 §2.7: the Vault Leech).
